name: the receiver of the first message
body:
sequenceDiagram
    Alice->>Bob: Could you please send me the signed contract today
after:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Alice
    participant Bob as Robert
    Alice->>Bob: Could you please send me the signed contract today

name: a participant between two long messages
body:
sequenceDiagram
    a->>b: Could you please send me the signed contract today
    b->>c: and the second copy of the same contract to the other office
after:
sequenceDiagram
    participant a
    participant b as Robert
    a->>b: Could you please send me the signed contract today
    b->>c: and the second copy of the same contract to the other office

name: a late bare declaration
body:
sequenceDiagram
    a->>b: Could you please send me the signed contract today
    participant b
    b->>a: y
after:
sequenceDiagram
    participant a
    participant b as Robert
    a->>b: Could you please send me the signed contract today
    participant b
    b->>a: y

name: first mentioned inside a block
body:
sequenceDiagram
    loop l
        x->>y: Could you please send me the signed contract today
        y->>z: and the second copy of the same contract to the other office
    end
after:
sequenceDiagram
    participant x
    participant y
    participant z as Robert
    loop l
        x->>y: Could you please send me the signed contract today
        y->>z: and the second copy of the same contract to the other office
    end
